Trailer Wraps in Toronto Starting From $450

Have a trailer that looks like every other trailer you see on the road? Want to give it a whole extra purpose without breaking the bank? Well, here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto we can help you with that. A trailer wrap is a perfect way to advertise your business or express yourself without the lengthy expensive process of a paint job.

A trailer wrap can be full, partial, or even just lettering and decals, whatever your idea is we can make it happen. You have made the investment in a trailer why not also add a little protection to it all while making it more noticeable on the road? A well-installed trailer wrap can help to protect your trailer from harsh elements and unpredictable dings and scratches of road debris. We laminate our vehicle vinyl to add extra protection to your wrap. This also adds UV protection to your trailer vinyl wrap to help keep your colours looking vibrant for longer.

We use only the highest quality Avery Dennison and 3M vinyl for our wrap jobs. With proven industry quality and an ever-growing range of colours and finishes to choose from you will not be disappointed in the results. Want some more info? Check out our what we use page to get familiar with the high-quality products we have available here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto.

One of the best reasons for choosing a trailer wrap is that the graphics can be removed without damaging your trailer, and you can have new ones added when you wish. This gives businesses the ability to design different looks depending on job type, seasonal requirements, or just to keep their mobile advertisements looking their best.

Here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we have wrapped trailers for some of the following industries:

  • Food Trailer Wraps
  • Moving Services Trailer Wraps
  • Landscaping Services Trailer Graphics
  • Personal Trailer Vinyl Wraps
  • Catering Trailer Graphics
  • Race Car Trailers
  • Ice Cream Trailers
  • Pet Grooming Services Trailer Graphics
  • Construction Services Trailers
  • Realty Services Trailers
